title: Container With Most Water
summary: Pick two vertical lines that, with the x-axis, hold the most water.

tests.explain: Lines at index 1 (height 8) and index 8 (height 7) are 7 apart. The water level is the shorter line, 7, so the area is 7 × 7 = 49.

hints: The area between lines i and j is (j - i) × min(height[i], height[j]). Trying every pair is O(n²).
Start with the widest container: one pointer at each end. Which pointer should move next?
Moving the taller line inward can never help: the width shrinks and the height is still capped by the shorter line. Always move the shorter one.

complexity.time: O(n): the pointers move n - 1 times in total
